title: Newspaper: Society, Education & Culture
sub: Vocabulary for features, editorials, and human-interest stories.

cards.def:
Unfair difference in wealth, rights, or opportunity.
हिंदी: असमानता
examples: Present: Inequality divides societies.
Past: Inequality widened after the crisis.
Future: Inequality will grow without reform.
Perfect: Inequality has become a major issue.

cards.def:
The state of lacking money for basic needs.
हिंदी: ग़रीबी
examples: Present: Poverty limits choices.
Past: Poverty fell in the last decade.
Future: Poverty will decline with jobs.
Perfect: Millions have escaped poverty.

cards.def:
Support for people's health and wellbeing.
हिंदी: कल्याण
examples: Present: Welfare helps those in need.
Past: Welfare expanded in the 1990s.
Future: Welfare will cover more families.
Perfect: The state has increased welfare spending.

cards.def:
The ability to read and write.
हिंदी: साक्षरता
examples: Present: Literacy opens opportunities.
Past: Literacy rose to ninety percent.
Future: Literacy will improve with new schools.
Perfect: The state has raised literacy.

cards.def:
The subjects taught in a school.
हिंदी: पाठ्यक्रम
examples: Present: A curriculum shapes learning.
Past: The curriculum changed in 2020.
Future: The curriculum will include coding.
Perfect: Schools have updated the curriculum.

cards.def:
Money awarded to support a student's education.
हिंदी: छात्रवृत्ति
examples: Present: A scholarship rewards merit.
Past: She won a scholarship to Oxford.
Future: He will apply for a scholarship.
Perfect: Many students have received scholarships.

cards.def:
To officially join a course or school.
हिंदी: नामांकन करना
examples: Present: Children enrol at age six.
Past: She enrolled in a design course.
Future: Students will enrol in July.
Perfect: Thousands have enrolled online.

cards.def:
A person who leaves school early.
हिंदी: पढ़ाई छोड़ने वाला
examples: Present: A dropout may struggle to find work.
Past: He became a dropout at fifteen.
Future: Dropouts will fall with free meals.
Perfect: Many girls have become dropouts.

cards.def:
Teaching, or the fee paid for it.
हिंदी: ट्यूशन / शिक्षण शुल्क
examples: Present: Tuition fees are rising.
Past: He paid tuition for three years.
Future: Tuition will increase next year.
Perfect: The college has raised tuition.

cards.def:
To complete a degree.
हिंदी: स्नातक होना
examples: Present: Students graduate after three years.
Past: She graduated in 2018.
Future: He will graduate in June.
Perfect: Many have graduated with honours.

cards.def:
Teaching staff of a school or college.
हिंदी: शिक्षक वर्ग / संकाय
examples: Present: The faculty guides students.
Past: The faculty voted to change the exam.
Future: The faculty will meet on Friday.
Perfect: The college has hired new faculty.

cards.def:
An experienced person who advises a younger one.
हिंदी: मार्गदर्शक
examples: Present: A mentor shares experience.
Past: She was my mentor for years.
Future: A mentor will guide new staff.
Perfect: He has mentored dozens of students.

cards.def:
The method and practice of teaching.
हिंदी: शिक्षण-शास्त्र
examples: Present: Pedagogy influences classroom success.
Past: New pedagogy transformed the school.
Future: Pedagogy will emphasise creativity.
Perfect: Teachers have embraced new pedagogy.

cards.def:
Relating to skills for a particular job.
हिंदी: व्यावसायिक
examples: Present: Vocational training prepares workers.
Past: He took a vocational course.
Future: Vocational courses will expand.
Perfect: The state has promoted vocational education.

cards.def:
Social and cultural roles linked to being male or female.
हिंदी: लिंग
examples: Present: Gender should not limit opportunity.
Past: Gender bias shaped the policy.
Future: Gender equality will take time.
Perfect: The firm has achieved gender balance.

cards.def:
Unfair treatment based on identity.
हिंदी: भेदभाव
examples: Present: Discrimination harms society.
Past: Discrimination caused outrage.
Future: Discrimination will be punished by law.
Perfect: He has faced discrimination at work.

cards.def:
Opinion formed without knowledge or reason.
हिंदी: पूर्वाग्रह
examples: Present: Prejudice blinds judgement.
Past: Prejudice affected the hiring.
Future: Education will reduce prejudice.
Perfect: Many have overcome prejudice.

cards.def:
A fixed, oversimplified idea about a group.
हिंदी: रूढ़िबद्ध धारणा
examples: Present: A stereotype misleads people.
Past: The film challenged a stereotype.
Future: Stereotypes will fade with awareness.
Perfect: Society has long held that stereotype.

cards.def:
A range of different people or things.
हिंदी: विविधता
examples: Present: Diversity enriches teams.
Past: Diversity improved the company.
Future: Diversity will strengthen the workplace.
Perfect: The school has embraced diversity.

cards.def:
Including everyone.
हिंदी: समावेशी
examples: Present: An inclusive policy welcomes all.
Past: The event was inclusive.
Future: Inclusive growth will benefit more people.
Perfect: The school has become inclusive.

cards.def:
Pushed to the edge of society.
हिंदी: हाशिये पर रखा गया
examples: Present: Marginalised groups need support.
Past: Villagers felt marginalised.
Future: Marginalised voices will be heard.
Perfect: The community has long been marginalised.

cards.def:
Traditions and history passed down.
हिंदी: विरासत
examples: Present: Heritage connects generations.
Past: The temple became a heritage site.
Future: Heritage will attract tourists.
Perfect: The state has preserved its heritage.

cards.def:
A custom passed down over generations.
हिंदी: परंपरा
examples: Present: Tradition shapes festivals.
Past: The tradition began centuries ago.
Future: The tradition will continue.
Perfect: Families have kept the tradition alive.

cards.def:
A set of actions performed in a fixed way.
हिंदी: अनुष्ठान / रस्म
examples: Present: A ritual marks important moments.
Past: The ritual lasted three days.
Future: The ritual will begin at dawn.
Perfect: Families have performed the ritual for years.

cards.def:
A celebration held on a special occasion.
हिंदी: त्योहार
examples: Present: A festival brings communities together.
Past: The festival drew huge crowds.
Future: The festival will start tomorrow.
Perfect: The city has hosted the festival for decades.

cards.def:
A journey to a sacred place.
हिंदी: तीर्थयात्रा
examples: Present: A pilgrimage is deeply spiritual.
Past: She made a pilgrimage to Varanasi.
Future: Thousands will join the pilgrimage.
Perfect: Devotees have completed the pilgrimage.

cards.def:
A building or statue honouring something.
हिंदी: स्मारक
examples: Present: A monument recalls history.
Past: The monument was built in 1650.
Future: The monument will be restored.
Perfect: Archaeologists have protected the monument.

cards.def:
A public display of art or objects.
हिंदी: प्रदर्शनी
examples: Present: An exhibition attracts visitors.
Past: The exhibition ran for a month.
Future: The exhibition will open in May.
Perfect: The museum has organised an exhibition.

cards.def:
The first public showing of a film or play.
हिंदी: प्रथम प्रदर्शन
examples: Present: A premiere draws celebrities.
Past: The premiere took place in Mumbai.
Future: The premiere will happen on Friday.
Perfect: The film has already had its premiere.

cards.def:
Praised publicly.
हिंदी: प्रशंसित
examples: Present: An acclaimed author draws readers.
Past: The film was critically acclaimed.
Future: The acclaimed singer will perform tonight.
Perfect: The writer has become acclaimed worldwide.

cards.def:
A hugely successful film or product.
हिंदी: सुपरहिट फ़िल्म
examples: Present: A blockbuster earns millions.
Past: The blockbuster broke records.
Future: The blockbuster will release in summer.
Perfect: The studio has produced another blockbuster.

cards.def:
A factual film about real events.
हिंदी: वृत्तचित्र
examples: Present: A documentary informs viewers.
Past: The documentary won an award.
Future: The documentary will air on Sunday.
Perfect: The director has made a documentary.

cards.def:
A person who reviews art or ideas.
हिंदी: आलोचक
examples: Present: A critic shares opinions.
Past: The critic praised the novel.
Future: The critic will review the play.
Perfect: Critics have loved the film.

cards.def:
A collection of poems, stories, or songs.
हिंदी: संकलन
examples: Present: An anthology gathers works together.
Past: The anthology featured twenty writers.
Future: An anthology will be published next year.
Perfect: The editor has compiled an anthology.

cards.def:
An account of someone's life.
हिंदी: जीवनी
examples: Present: A biography tells a life story.
Past: The biography became a bestseller.
Future: A biography will be released in May.
Perfect: She has written a biography of Gandhi.

cards.def:
An article expressing the newspaper's opinion.
हिंदी: संपादकीय
examples: Present: An editorial shapes public debate.
Past: The editorial criticised the plan.
Future: An editorial will appear tomorrow.
Perfect: The paper has published a strong editorial.

cards.def:
The title at the top of a news story.
हिंदी: शीर्षक / सुर्खी
examples: Present: A headline attracts attention.
Past: The headline shocked readers.
Future: The headline will appear on page one.
Perfect: The story has made headlines.

cards.def:
A person who reports news.
हिंदी: पत्रकार
examples: Present: A journalist checks facts.
Past: The journalist exposed the fraud.
Future: The journalist will interview the minister.
Perfect: She has worked as a journalist for ten years.

cards.def:
Unfair leaning toward one side.
हिंदी: पक्षपात
examples: Present: Bias can affect reporting.
Past: Bias crept into the coverage.
Future: Bias will reduce trust.
Perfect: Readers have noticed bias.

cards.def:
False information spread without intent to deceive.
हिंदी: ग़लत जानकारी
examples: Present: Misinformation spreads quickly online.
Past: Misinformation caused panic.
Future: Misinformation will erode trust.
Perfect: Platforms have fought misinformation.

cards.def:
Information spread to promote a cause, often misleading.
हिंदी: प्रचार
examples: Present: Propaganda shapes opinion.
Past: Propaganda filled the airwaves.
Future: Propaganda will deepen divisions.
Perfect: The regime has used propaganda.

cards.def:
Suppressing speech or publications.
हिंदी: सेंसरशिप
examples: Present: Censorship restricts free expression.
Past: Censorship banned the book.
Future: Censorship will provoke criticism.
Perfect: The state has imposed censorship.

cards.def:
Spreading rapidly online.
हिंदी: वायरल
examples: Present: A viral video can make a star.
Past: The post went viral overnight.
Future: The clip will go viral.
Perfect: The meme has gone viral.

cards.def:
A person who shapes opinions on social media.
हिंदी: इन्फ्लुएंसर
examples: Present: An influencer promotes brands.
Past: The influencer visited Goa.
Future: The influencer will launch a product.
Perfect: She has become a popular influencer.

cards.def:
The right to keep personal matters private.
हिंदी: निजता
examples: Present: Privacy needs protection.
Past: Privacy was violated in the leak.
Future: Privacy will be central to the law.
Perfect: Users have demanded stronger privacy.

cards.def:
The growth of cities and urban living.
हिंदी: शहरीकरण
examples: Present: Urbanisation increases traffic.
Past: Urbanisation accelerated in the 1990s.
Future: Urbanisation will strain resources.
Perfect: The region has seen rapid urbanisation.

cards.def:
Movement of people from one place to another.
हिंदी: प्रवास
examples: Present: Migration reshapes communities.
Past: Migration increased after the drought.
Future: Migration will continue to cities.
Perfect: Migration has changed the village.

cards.def:
A crowded, poor urban area.
हिंदी: झुग्गी-बस्ती
examples: Present: A slum lacks proper sanitation.
Past: The slum was cleared last year.
Future: The slum will be redeveloped.
Perfect: Residents have lived in the slum for decades.

cards.def:
Systems that keep places clean and healthy.
हिंदी: स्वच्छता
examples: Present: Sanitation prevents disease.
Past: Sanitation improved in villages.
Future: Sanitation will receive more funding.
Perfect: The city has upgraded sanitation.

cards.def:
Overcrowding, especially of traffic.
हिंदी: भीड़-भाड़ / जाम
examples: Present: Congestion wastes time.
Past: Congestion worsened during rush hour.
Future: Congestion will ease with the metro.
Perfect: Congestion has grown with population.

cards.def:
To travel regularly between home and work.
हिंदी: रोज़ आना-जाना करना
examples: Present: Many people commute by train.
Past: He commuted two hours daily.
Future: She will commute by metro.
Perfect: I have commuted for ten years.

cards.def:
A person walking, not driving.
हिंदी: पैदल यात्री
examples: Present: A pedestrian needs safe crossings.
Past: A pedestrian was hit by a bus.
Future: Pedestrians will get wider pavements.
Perfect: The city has built a pedestrian bridge.

cards.def:
Buses, trains, and similar shared services.
हिंदी: सार्वजनिक परिवहन
examples: Present: Public transport reduces traffic.
Past: Public transport improved after the metro.
Future: Public transport will grow.
Perfect: The city has expanded public transport.

cards.def:
Cheap enough for most people.
हिंदी: किफ़ायती
examples: Present: Affordable housing helps families.
Past: Affordable flats sold quickly.
Future: Affordable healthcare will reach villages.
Perfect: The scheme has made homes affordable.

cards.def:
A person who rents property.
हिंदी: किरायेदार
examples: Present: A tenant pays monthly rent.
Past: The tenant left in March.
Future: The tenant will move next week.
Perfect: The tenants have complained about repairs.

cards.def:
A person who rents out property.
हिंदी: मकान मालिक
examples: Present: A landlord maintains the property.
Past: The landlord raised the rent.
Future: The landlord will inspect the flat.
Perfect: The landlord has sold the building.

cards.def:
Having no home.
हिंदी: बेघर
examples: Present: Homeless people need shelter.
Past: The flood left thousands homeless.
Future: Thousands will be homeless by winter.
Perfect: The earthquake has left many homeless.

cards.def:
An organisation helping people in need.
हिंदी: दान-संस्था / परोपकार
examples: Present: A charity depends on donations.
Past: The charity raised millions.
Future: The charity will build a school.
Perfect: The charity has helped thousands.

cards.def:
A person who works without pay.
हिंदी: स्वयंसेवक
examples: Present: A volunteer gives time freely.
Past: A volunteer helped the flood victims.
Future: Volunteers will clean the beach.
Perfect: She has volunteered for years.

cards.def:
To give money or goods to help.
हिंदी: दान करना
examples: Present: People donate to causes they care about.
Past: He donated blood.
Future: Companies will donate food.
Perfect: Citizens have donated generously.

cards.def:
Concerned with improving human welfare.
हिंदी: मानवीय
examples: Present: Humanitarian aid saves lives.
Past: Humanitarian groups reached the camp.
Future: Humanitarian help will arrive soon.
Perfect: Agencies have delivered humanitarian supplies.

cards.def:
Able to recover quickly from difficulty.
हिंदी: लचीला / दृढ़
examples: Present: A resilient community rebuilds quickly.
Past: The town was resilient after the storm.
Future: Resilient firms will survive the crisis.
Perfect: The village has proven resilient.

cards.def:
Easily harmed or hurt.
हिंदी: असुरक्षित / कमज़ोर
examples: Present: Vulnerable people need protection.
Past: Villages were vulnerable to flood.
Future: Vulnerable groups will get priority.
Perfect: The elderly have been vulnerable.

cards.def:
Deep sorrow, especially after a death.
हिंदी: शोक
examples: Present: Grief affects everyone differently.
Past: Grief overwhelmed the family.
Future: Grief will ease with time.
Perfect: She has endured great grief.

cards.def:
An act showing respect or admiration.
हिंदी: श्रद्धांजलि
examples: Present: A tribute honours the departed.
Past: Leaders paid tribute to the soldiers.
Future: Fans will pay tribute tomorrow.
Perfect: The city has built a tribute.

cards.def:
A formal event marking an occasion.
हिंदी: समारोह
examples: Present: A ceremony marks achievements.
Past: The ceremony began at noon.
Future: The ceremony will be held in the stadium.
Perfect: The school has organised a ceremony.

cards.def:
The yearly date of a past event.
हिंदी: वर्षगाँठ
examples: Present: An anniversary reminds us of history.
Past: The anniversary was celebrated nationwide.
Future: The anniversary will be marked tomorrow.
Perfect: The country has reached its 75th anniversary.

cards.def:
Something handed down from the past.
हिंदी: विरासत / धरोहर
examples: Present: A legacy outlives its creator.
Past: He left a legacy of kindness.
Future: Her legacy will inspire many.
Perfect: The leader has built a lasting legacy.

cards.def:
A widely admired person or symbol.
हिंदी: प्रतीक / आइकन
examples: Present: An icon inspires people.
Past: She became a cultural icon.
Future: He will remain an icon.
Perfect: The singer has become a global icon.

cards.def:
A person with long experience, especially in the military.
हिंदी: अनुभवी / भूतपूर्व सैनिक
examples: Present: A veteran shares hard-won lessons.
Past: The veteran retired in 2010.
Future: The veteran will receive an award.
Perfect: He has served as a veteran journalist.

cards.def:
A young person with exceptional talent.
हिंदी: अद्भुत प्रतिभा
examples: Present: A prodigy masters skills early.
Past: He was a chess prodigy.
Future: The prodigy will perform tonight.
Perfect: She has been called a prodigy.

cards.def:
A person trained for sports.
हिंदी: खिलाड़ी / एथलीट
examples: Present: An athlete trains daily.
Past: The athlete broke a record.
Future: The athlete will compete in Paris.
Perfect: She has won three medals.

cards.def:
A series of contests to find a winner.
हिंदी: टूर्नामेंट
examples: Present: A tournament lasts several days.
Past: The tournament ended in a draw.
Future: The tournament will begin in June.
Perfect: The team has reached the tournament final.

cards.def:
Failure to win.
हिंदी: हार
examples: Present: A defeat teaches humility.
Past: The team suffered a heavy defeat.
Future: A defeat will end their hopes.
Perfect: They have avoided defeat all season.

cards.def:
A great victory or achievement.
हिंदी: विजय / सफलता
examples: Present: A triumph brings joy.
Past: The win was a triumph for the team.
Future: Success will be a triumph for the nation.
Perfect: The film has been a triumph.

cards.def:
A person or team competing with another.
हिंदी: प्रतिद्वंद्वी
examples: Present: A rival pushes you to improve.
Past: The rival beat him in the final.
Future: The rival will challenge her again.
Perfect: The two have been rivals for years.

cards.def:
A person watching an event.
हिंदी: दर्शक
examples: Present: A spectator cheers for the team.
Past: A spectator caught the ball.
Future: Spectators will fill the stadium.
Perfect: Thousands of spectators have arrived.

cards.def:
A large arena for sports events.
हिंदी: स्टेडियम
examples: Present: A stadium holds many fans.
Past: The stadium was packed.
Future: The stadium will host the final.
Perfect: The city has built a new stadium.

cards.def:
A person who trains athletes or teams.
हिंदी: प्रशिक्षक
examples: Present: A coach plans training.
Past: The coach resigned after the loss.
Future: The coach will announce the squad.
Perfect: The coach has led the team to victory.

cards.def:
A group selected for a team or task.
हिंदी: दल
examples: Present: A squad needs balance.
Past: The squad was announced last week.
Future: The squad will travel on Monday.
Perfect: The coach has picked a young squad.

cards.def:
To meet the conditions to enter or continue.
हिंदी: क्वालीफ़ाई करना
examples: Present: Teams qualify through rounds.
Past: They qualified for the final.
Future: She will qualify if she wins.
Perfect: He has qualified for the Olympics.

cards.def:
A metal disc awarded for achievement.
हिंदी: पदक
examples: Present: A medal rewards excellence.
Past: She won a gold medal.
Future: He will compete for a medal.
Perfect: The nation has collected ten medals.

cards.def:
The best performance ever achieved.
हिंदी: रिकॉर्ड
examples: Present: A record inspires athletes.
Past: She broke the world record.
Future: He will try to break the record.
Perfect: The team has set a new record.

cards.def:
The condition of being physically healthy.
हिंदी: तंदुरुस्ती
examples: Present: Fitness needs regular exercise.
Past: Fitness improved after training.
Future: Fitness will decide the winner.
Perfect: Players have maintained high fitness.

cards.def:
The ability to keep going despite difficulty.
हिंदी: सहनशक्ति
examples: Present: Endurance matters in long races.
Past: Endurance carried her through the marathon.
Future: Endurance will be tested on the climb.
Perfect: He has shown great endurance.

cards.def:
Training oneself to follow rules and routines.
हिंदी: अनुशासन
examples: Present: Discipline leads to success.
Past: Discipline helped him pass the exam.
Future: Discipline will keep the team strong.
Perfect: The coach has instilled discipline.

cards.def:
To try to win against others.
हिंदी: प्रतिस्पर्धा करना
examples: Present: Firms compete for customers.
Past: She competed in three events.
Future: Teams will compete next month.
Perfect: He has competed at the national level.

cards.def:
A strong feeling or mood, like team spirit.
हिंदी: भावना / उत्साह
examples: Present: Team spirit lifts performance.
Past: Spirit carried them through the storm.
Future: Spirit will matter in the final.
Perfect: The crowd has shown great spirit.

cards.def:
Fair and generous behaviour in sport.
हिंदी: खेल भावना
examples: Present: Sportsmanship earns respect.
Past: His sportsmanship impressed fans.
Future: Sportsmanship will be rewarded.
Perfect: The team has shown true sportsmanship.

cards.def:
A song of identity for a nation or team.
हिंदी: राष्ट्रगान / गीत
examples: Present: An anthem unites crowds.
Past: The anthem played before the match.
Future: The anthem will be sung at the start.
Perfect: The team has learned the anthem.

cards.def:
A major event or a well-known place.
हिंदी: ऐतिहासिक मील का पत्थर / प्रसिद्ध स्थल
examples: Present: A landmark guides visitors.
Past: The ruling was a landmark in law.
Future: The tower will remain a landmark.
Perfect: The building has become a city landmark.
